sets.title: 嘉玲正着下楼·楼梯底部固定机位·v6 服装锁定

shots.prompt:
<Prompt>

<Subject Definitions>
<Subject 1>: a 17-year-old Chinese high school girl with wavy auburn-red hair falling past her shoulders, solemn expression, wearing EXACTLY: (a) a black floor-length hooded robe that covers her entire body from shoulders down to her ankles, with NO opening in the front, NO visible shirt collar or tie peeking out, NO scarf around her neck, (b) a simple black inner garment fully hidden under the robe, (c) bare feet or simple black flat shoes entirely concealed under the robe hem, holding a wooden wand in one hand, [Picture 1]
<Subject 2>: the vast ruined gothic castle great hall: carved stone altar in the center with a single glowing lantern on top, two rows of tall carved stone columns, tall stained-glass arched windows, a grand spiral stone staircase on the right wall, a broken stone dome, thick cobwebs, scattered candles, thin mist, cold dark teal-grey palette with warm candle-glow accents, high contrast, fine grain, close view of the spiral stone staircase as seen from its base, [Picture 2]

<Summary>
STATIC FIXED CAMERA at the base of the spiral stone staircase, the camera never moves, never pans, never tilts, never zooms. The girl matching Picture 1 descends the spiral staircase from the upper landing straight toward the camera, stepping down one tread at a time, each foot landing on a lower step, facing the camera the entire time, her face clearly visible, looking at the steps and then up at the viewer. As she descends she comes progressively closer and larger in the frame, ending in a medium-close view near the camera. DESCENT RULE: she is walking DOWN the stairs toward the hall floor, she never climbs up, never turns around, never walks backward, never walks away from the camera. Weather and lighting: dark gothic hall, warm candle sconces on the stair wall, thin mist below. Color grade: cold dark teal-grey with warm candle accents, high contrast, fine grain.

<Retention Analysis>
Subject 1: fully_preserved - identical girl, identical black floor-length hooded robe, do not alter face, do not alter hair, do not alter robe silhouette
Picture 1: fully_preserved
Subject 2: partially_preserved - scene geometry anchor, keep the spiral staircase structure, curve direction, railing and candle sconces exactly consistent with Picture 2; the staircase ascends from the lower hall floor up toward the upper landing exactly as shown in Picture 2
Picture 2: partially_preserved

<Detailed Description>
Fixed camera at the stair base. The girl matching Picture 1 appears at the upper landing of the spiral staircase and walks down toward the camera: step by step, each foot landing on a lower tread, her free hand gliding along the stone railing, wand held in the other hand, the black floor-length robe swaying naturally with each descending step, the robe hem brushing each step she steps down on, the robe covering her entire legs down to her ankles so that no knees, no skirt, no socks are ever visible at any point in the shot. Her face is oriented toward the camera and toward the downward slope for the whole shot, eyes checking the steps ahead then lifting to the viewer. The camera stays perfectly still, so she grows from a distant figure to a medium-close figure as she approaches, her movement through the frame obvious and readable. She is clearly walking DOWNSTAIRS the entire time, arriving at the stair base near the camera at the end.

CLOTHING LOCK: the girl is wearing EXACTLY one continuous black floor-length hooded robe from shoulders to ankles. There is NO school uniform. There is NO gray pleated skirt. There is NO striped scarf around her neck. There is NO white shirt collar or tie peeking out. There are NO knee socks or over-the-knee socks. There are NO leather shoes or Mary Janes. The black robe is the only visible garment; nothing else is worn, nothing else is visible.

Weather and lighting: dark gothic hall, warm candle sconces along the stair wall, thin mist drifting near the stair base.
Color grade: cold dark teal-grey with warm candle-glow accents, high contrast, fine grain.
All dialogue in Chinese, no other language, no narration.

<Overall Soundscape>
boots striking stone steps one by one, the rhythm growing closer and louder as she approaches, robes swishing, hand brushing the stone railing, candle flames, deep hall ambience

<Non-Diegetic Music>
mysterious low strings, a rising feminine choral line, restrained

</Prompt>
